audit.whatIsWrong: Row 2 said Fiora while whys[2] calls it genuinely even; row 3 said Skill while whys[3] says she can still all-in you; rows 5 and 6 disagreed with whys[5] and whys[6], which both hand the game to Kayle.
audit.why: At level 3 Celestial Blessing plus Radiant Blast's shred stabilises the trade; at first item and beyond a ranged Kayle kites Lunge entirely.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill, row 3 to Fiora, rows 5 and 6 to Kayle in both layers with ratings matched — exactly the chart the Fiora-side audit landed on, including keeping Level 6 on Fiora.

audit.why: spikes[] key level 6 to Divine Ascent plus Divine Judgment, first item to Nashor's with Starfire on-hit, and the 2+ item / level-16 ranged form.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says three times that Riposte parries Radiant Blast 'for a stun'. Riot's text stuns only if Riposte blocked an immobilizing effect — Radiant Blast slows, so a parried Q returns a slow, not a stun. No ability names or cooldowns appeared in the tracking fields either.
audit.why: A player who believes their Q hands Fiora a free stun will simply stop casting it, giving up the resistance shred that makes the matchup winnable. The real cost of a parried Q is the lost damage and the slow that follows.
audit.corrected: whys[3] and spikes[3] rewritten to the real parry behaviour; cooldowns, dos and donts and report[5] now carry Riposte 24s, Lunge 13s, Grand Challenge 110s and the anti-heal call.

edits.before: Pre-6 she can still Q-in and all-in you before Divine Ascent goes ranged, and her W can parry your Q skillshot for a stun.
edits.after: Pre-6 she can still Lunge in and all-in you before Divine Ascent goes ranged, and Riposte parries the damage of your Radiant Blast.

edits.before: Your fully-ranged kit makes you a hyper-carry that kites her off the splitpush, but respect her W — a clean parry on your Q can still stun you and let her vitals burst you if she catches you flat-footed.
edits.after: Your fully-ranged kit makes you a hyper-carry that kites her off the splitpush, but respect Riposte — it eats your Radiant Blast outright and slows you, which is all the window her vitals need.

edits.before: Parries + stuns. Respect it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riposte is 24s at rank 1, and it only stuns if it blocks a stun.

edits.before: Fiora wastes Riposte — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Her vitals and Grand Challenge heal — buy Oblivion Orb early.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is 110s and heals her whole side on completion.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — it parries all damage, but only stuns if it blocked an immobilise, and your Q merely slows. - Lunge: 13s at rank 1. - Grand Challenge: 110s, and it heals her.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries + stuns. Respect it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Track Riposte, 24s at rank 1: it parries damage, but your Q only slows, so no stun.

notes: The 'W parry stuns your Q' claim also survives in content.early, content.late and wants.foe[1]; those strings have no room to carry the correction inside the length band without dropping the rest of their advice, so they are flagged rather than half-rewritten. Riot's text is unambiguous: Riposte stuns only when it blocks an immobilizing effect.
